# The workload both runs share, as Python. Sizes, lifetimes
# and intervals are in kB: one simulated object is 1 kB, 16
# real ones. Press Run or Ctrl+Enter to run it.

# A shape of your own is a function of i that gives the links
# object i brings, as (source, target) pairs among objects 0
# to i, one of them from an earlier object that holds object i.
# Own(...) takes it. It sees only i and what it imports itself.
def links(i):
    # The links object i brings, as (source, target) pairs
    # among objects 0 to i. One link from an earlier object
    # holds object i.
    if i == 0:
        return []
    # A doubly linked list: each object and the one before
    # it hold each other.
    return [(i - 1, i), (i, i - 1)]


def links_2(i):
    return [(0, i)] if i else []


def churn_2(i):
    return [(i - 1, i)] if i else []


shape_10 = """\
# A chain of four.
WIDTH = 4

def links(i):
    return [(max(i - WIDTH, 0), i)] if i else []
"""


shape_11 = "NAME = \"a\\tb\"\ndef links(i):\n    return [(0, i)] if i else []\n"


churn = Churn(lifetime_mean=5, cycle_share="3/100", cycle_size=3,
              long_share="1/20", long_lifetimes=(100, 1000))

structures = [
    Structure(Chains(16), size=8000, root="module"),
    Structure(Tree(), size=20_000, root="frame", lifetime=40_000,
              rebuild_interval=80_000, build_churn=1),
    Structure(Hierarchy(6), size=100, root="frame", lifetime=0,
              rebuild_interval=1000),
    Structure(Graph(2), size=100, root="module"),
    Structure(Rings(21), size=100, root="frame", lifetime=500,
              rebuild_interval=1000, full_collections=True),
    Structure(Own(links), size=1000, root="frame", lifetime=2000,
              rebuild_interval=4000),
    Structure(Own(links), size=500, root="module"),
    Structure(Own(links_2), size=50, root="frame"),
    Structure(Own(churn_2), size=50, root="frame"),
    Structure(Own(shape_10), size=50, root="frame"),
    Structure(Own(shape_11), size=50, root="frame"),
]

run_length = 150_000
settings = Settings(threshold0=2000, threshold1=10, threshold2=10)
shutdown = True
seed = 7
